# Rakibul AI Labs

> A research sandbox for local LLMs, agentic workflows, and self-hosted AI infrastructure. Built for privacy, speed, and absolute control.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rakibuilds.github.io/): Overview and featured experiments
- [Experiments](https://rakibuilds.github.io/experiments/): R&D deep dives
- [Lab Notes](https://rakibuilds.github.io/lab-notes/): Essays and thinking
- [Projects](https://rakibuilds.github.io/projects/): Live, deployed work
